name: Willie "the Lion" Smith
description: '''William Henry Joseph Bonaparte Bertholf Smith''' (November 23, 1893{{efn|Sometimes given as November 25, 1897; see "William Henry Smith" at the [http://www.doctorjazz.co.uk/draftcards2.html Doctor Jazz] website.}} – April 18, 1973), nicknamed "'''the Lion'''", was an American [[jazz]] and [[Stride (music)|stride]] [[Piano|pianist]].
